svg.title: Connected Frontiers architecture: Constructor, knowledge base, Reasoner with agentic harness, Examiner, Evaluator, Testbed, applications
svg.text: A versioned knowledge base of the AI ecosystem, built by curation, used by agents, and measured by a testbed. Dashed = planned.
free tool loop over the graph
Gates: evidence read · coverage reflection · synthesis check
Harness: schema card · empty-result hints · truncation notices · findings-linked advice
keys computed on the graph · solver gate
Every stage cached and resumable · trust is a status on each edge, not a hard gate · results logged with corrections
